title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f102v2 half amount is product reduction or input portion
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. GDT756 gives an admitted f102v2.35 ychor line whose complete working renderer includes an unconfirmed cooling-to-middle step. GDT755 cites the fourteenth-century BnF lat.8651 ink recipe with boil, strain, store and usque ad mediam partem: a named reduction of product volume. Freeze that full historical sequence and the complete admitted f102v2 record before interpreting any half-like whole. A reduction reading predicts one material carried through boiling and later smaller amount; a half-portion reading predicts two initial shares or a dose with no process-dependent shrinkage. Existing half-drying defaults are inherited hypotheses, not a binding. Raw unreviewed.

design.mechanism: a quantity fraction can measure process-caused reduction or an initially apportioned ingredient
design.unit: complete admitted f102v2.35 record and fixed BnF lat.8651 source sequence
design.contrast: remaining half after reduction versus half input portion or half dose
design.prediction: A process reading must preserve patient identity through heating and output quantity; a portion reading must introduce a separately measured input. A generic half expression leaves both open.
